<!--
This is for when the *platform itself* breaks — the escalation sweep goes
quiet, Alertmanager stops delivering, a bad migration takes down the API —
as opposed to RcaReport, which is in-product data about the *simulated*
bank fleet's incidents. Both use the same rootCauseCategory taxonomy
(HUMAN_ERROR, CONFIGURATION_CHANGE, CODE_DEFECT, INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE,
THIRD_PARTY_DEPENDENCY, CAPACITY_LIMIT, PROCESS_GAP) on purpose — one
vocabulary for "why did this break," whether it's the tool or the thing
the tool monitors.
-->
